name: Vantage
source:
A man goes back to the countryside to meet his childhood friend. But she is not who she is.

An official entry to the Manila Game Jam 2014, which is part of the [url=http://globalgamejam.org/]Global Game Jam 2014[/url].

[From [url=http://dagitabsoft.wordpress.com/visual-novels/]DagitabSoft[/url]]
translation:
一个男人回到乡下去见他儿时的朋友。但她不再是她了。

2014年马尼拉Game Jam的正式参赛作品，该赛事是[url=http://globalgamejam.org/]2014年全球游戏大赛[/url]。

[来自[url=http://dagitabsoft.wordpress.com/visual-novels/]达吉塔软件[/url]]
